Arena configuration may vary only among challenge-equivalent options—e.g., which arena fixture activates—using the seeded deterministic stream. The same seed and inputs must reproduce the same fight, preserving golden tests. [yan-mo-main/CLAUDE.md:20](#)

Enemy behavior, tells, and outcomes must remain pure functions of state: no crit, dodge, damage variance, or random enemy decisions. Difficulty may change only the read-window, never randomness. Bare `random()`/`randi()`, wall-clock timing, and unordered iteration remain forbidden; the seeded `DealStream` is the sole entropy source.
